input.gcd_norm_definition: norm(shared_zero_mask_gcd), reconstructed from exact common ideal factors

limitations: All pair contributions remain signed; absolute pair sums are not used as a substitute.
RR, cross, and AA are retained in both main and remainder, with physical/raw signed subtotals.
A smaller finite-panel remainder is a diagnostic only; no bound for the main term is proved.
scope: finite saved panel only; no cofinal CF22 estimate or gain is proved

trivial_reference.label: TRIVIAL_FULL_PANEL_NO_REMAINDER
trivial_reference.meaning: G exceeds every saved pair gcd norm, so main is all C and remainder is empty
